svg.text: BLUEPRINT 03: GRADIENT (grad phi), DIRECTIONAL DERIVATIVES & LEVEL SURFACES ENGINE
Del Operator • Steepest Ascent Vector • Orthogonality to Level Sets • Directional Derivative D_u phi • Radial Gradients

g.text: Vector differential operator acting on a scalar field phi(x, y, z):
grad(phi) = grad phi = (dphi/dx) i + (dphi/dy) j + (dphi/dz) k
Converts a scalar field into a vector field.
Points in the direction of MAXIMUM rate of increase of phi.
|grad phi| equals the maximum spatial rate of change.
ORTHOGONALITY TO LEVEL SURFACES phi(x, y, z) = C
Proof via chain rule: Along any curve r(t) on phi=C, dphi/dt = grad phi . (dr/dt) = 0 => grad phi perp Tangent vector!
TANGENT PLANE AT P(x_0, y_0, z_0):
NORMAL LINE AT P(x_0, y_0, z_0):
cos(theta) = | grad phi_1 . grad phi_2 | / ( |grad phi_1| |grad phi_2| )
Orthogonal Surfaces Condition: grad phi_1 . grad phi_2 = 0
2. THE DIRECTIONAL DERIVATIVE D_u phi ENGINE
DEFINITION: RATE OF CHANGE ALONG ARBITRARY UNIT VECTOR u
D_u phi = (dphi/ds)_u = grad phi . u_cap = |grad phi| cos(theta)
Tangent to Level Surface phi = C
SOLVED CHALKBOARD DRILL: f(x, y) = x^2 + y^2 AT P(1, 2)
Task: Find directional derivative at (1, 2) in the direction of vector V = 4i + 3j.
Step 2: Compute Maximum Rate of Change:
|grad f(1, 2)| = sqrt( 2^2 + 4^2 ) = sqrt( 4 + 16 ) = sqrt(20) = 2 sqrt(5) approx 4.47
Step 3: Construct Unit Direction Vector u_cap:
Step 4: Take the Dot Product D_u f = grad f . u_cap:
GATE QUADRATIC FORM MAX RATE DRILL (SLIDE 119)
Given f(x_1, x_2) = x_1^2 + 2x_2^2 + x_1 x_2 + 3x_1 + 3x_2 + 1. Find max rate of change at (1, 1):
3. Gradient Vector: grad f(1, 1) = 6 a_x1 + 8 a_x2
MAXIMUM RATE OF CHANGE = MAGNITUDE OF GRADIENT:
r = x i + y j + z k | r = |r| = sqrt( x^2 + y^2 + z^2 )
dr/dx = x / sqrt(x^2+y^2+z^2) = x / r | dr/dy = y / r | dr/dz = z / r
grad r = (x/r)i + (y/r)j + (z/r)k = r / r = r_cap (UNIT RADIAL VECTOR)
grad [ f(r) ] = f'(r) grad r = f'(r) r_cap = [ f'(r) / r ] r
n r^(n-1) r_cap = n r^(n-2) r
r_cap / r = r / r^2 = r^-2 r
GATE EXAM ALERT: THE INVERSE SQUARE FORCE GRADIENT
With unit vector r_cap: grad(1/r) = -r_cap / r^2 [Power of r is 2]
With vector r: grad(1/r) = -r / r^3 [Power of r is 3!]
Mixing up r_cap and r causes missing powers of r in GATE options!
